newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Ramayana says revises up 1997 net.
newsitem.headline: Ramayana says revises up 1997 net.

text.p: Indonesian retailer Ramayana Lestari Sentosa said on Monday it had revised up its 1997 net profit to around 90.2 billion rupiah from 83.3 billion.
"We have just revised up our 1997 net profit forecast to around ninety billion rupiah," president director Agus Makmur told Reuters.
Makmur also said the company expected to book a net profit of 70.1 billion rupiah in 1996, against 43.2 billion rupiah in 1995.
The company had previously forecast 1996 net profit at 67 billion rupiah. The full-year earnings are likely to be announced later this month.
Makmur said the firm expected to achieve the new 1997 target due to expected higher demand following an encourgaing performance in 1996.
